Transfer last 32000 adjusted samples into panel FIFO then append remaining processed audio. Device compares FIFO against its complete processed stream sample-by-sample. Continue running detectors for shadow comparisons. Speech-presence labels and transcripts do not enter device code. Final partial input read zero padded. QEMU reference FFT and esp-nn ANSI C.
